kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نعتصب (form VIII)
# نَعْتَصِبُ (naʕtaṣibu) /naʕ.ta.sˤi.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِعْتَصَبَ (iʕtaṣaba)
# نَعْتَصِبَ (naʕtaṣiba) /naʕ.ta.sˤi.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِعْتَصَبَ (iʕtaṣaba)
# نَعْتَصِبْ (naʕtaṣib) /naʕ.ta.sˤib/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِعْتَصَبَ (iʕtaṣaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
